Adds near-term liquidity to address payables and debt.
Indicates modest funding scale; limits runway impact.
Sets reference pricing; implies equity dilution.
Creates potential future dilution if shares trade >$1.25.
Proceeds go to liabilities and promo, not growth capex.

This is a small-cap funding step, finalizing a previously announced private placement to shore up working capital. A larger financing, revenue traction from its peptide strategy, or regulatory milestones would be needed to become a major catalyst.
